use_case: Dam-safety sensor anomaly detection: flags unusual patterns in 410 instrument readings (piezometers, seepage weirs, inclinometers, reservoir and tailwater levels) at all 4 dams
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted and seasonal models built by the Data Analytics team on the dam safety data platform (SYS-14)
data_categories: Instrument readings (Confidential; some CEII); rainfall; reservoir levels
affects_individuals: No (no decision about a person); downstream populations bear the safety risk
human_in_the_loop: Every alert dispositioned by a dam safety technician; Chief Dam Safety Engineer decides any action; manual trend reviews and trigger-point checks unchanged
applicable_laws: 18 CFR 12.10(a) and 12.3(b)(4)(viii) (duty unchanged); FERC Security Program Rev. 3A 3.2 (trigger points) and Section 9 (one-way data path); CEII handling (18 CFR 388.113)
status: In use (advisory dashboards since 2026-01); approve with conditions

use_case: Reservoir inflow forecasting for Blackwater Bend and Cedar Shoals (24 to 72 hours ahead) used in daily release and pre-flood planning
vendor_or_model: In-house machine learning model on river gauge, rainfall, and public weather forecast data (SYS-14)
data_categories: Gauge and weather data; reservoir data (Internal)
affects_individuals: No (no decision about a person); downstream populations and recreation users bear the risk
human_in_the_loop: ROC shift supervisor decides releases using the rule curve, the public river forecast, and the model; model never sets gates
applicable_laws: License operating requirements (rule curves, minimum flows); EAP flood procedures (18 CFR 12.20 to 12.25, related); FERC Security Program Section 9 (no path to SCADA)
status: In use since 2025-10; approve with conditions
